lastRequest: Build a modern, dark-themed study tracker and Pomodoro dashboard using React. It should feature an interactive Pomodoro timer with customizable focus/break intervals, a daily study habits checklist, session logging categorized by subject (e.g., Coding, Math, Design) with a history table, real-time study statistics (like total focus hours and weekly progress bars), a glassmorphism theme, smooth transition animations, and responsive layouts styled with Tailwind CSS.

tasks.title: Project Setup and Core Types
tasks.description: Initialize React Vite TypeScript application with Tailwind CSS, define core domain models (Pomodoro sessions, tasks, study logs), and set up local storage repository layer.

tasks.title: Pomodoro Timer Engine
tasks.description: Implement robust countdown timer hook with web workers/state management for work, short break, and long break cycles, audio notifications, and session persistence.

tasks.title: Task Management Module
tasks.description: Build task creation, editing, deletion, prioritization, and completion tracking linked directly to Pomodoro timer sessions.

tasks.title: Analytics Dashboard and Charts
tasks.description: Create statistics view aggregating study time, completed sessions, and daily streaks using clean data visualization components.

tasks.title: UI Integration and Validation
tasks.description: Assemble dashboard layout with responsive Tailwind design, test edge cases, ensure state synchronization, and verify production build.
